faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.q1: How long does a website take?
faq.a1: A starter website is ready in 1–2 weeks. Business and Premium projects take 3–6 weeks depending on scope. We discuss the exact timeline in the first meeting.
faq.q2: What do I need to get started?
faq.a2: Nothing but an idea. We guide you through the entire process — from conception through content to go-live.
faq.a3: Hosting and domain cost about 10–20 €/month. Our maintenance packages from 29 €/month are optional but recommended.
faq.q4: What if I want changes later?
faq.a4: No problem. With a maintenance package, small changes are included. Larger adjustments are billed as individual services.
faq.q5: Can I edit my website myself?
faq.a5: Yes. If needed, we integrate a CMS (e.g., Sanity or Contentful) so you can update text and images yourself.
faq.a6: Yes — from 1,200 € we build complete online shops with payment processing, product management, and more.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.updated: Last updated: 2026 · in accordance with GDPR (EU) 2016/679 and Austrian Data Protection Act
privacy.section1Desc: The responsible party within the meaning of the GDPR for the processing of personal data on this website is:
privacy.section2Desc: We collect and process the following categories of personal data:
privacy.data1: Contact details: Name, email address, phone number (when contacting us)
privacy.data2: Communication data: Content of messages via our contact form
privacy.data3: Usage data: IP address, browser, operating system, page views (when using analytics)
privacy.data4: Technical data: Cookies, session data (technically necessary)
privacy.section3: 3. Purposes and legal bases of processing
privacy.section3ContactDesc: If you contact us via the contact form or by email, we process your data to handle your inquiry on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR (contract initiation) or Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in responding to inquiries). Data is not passed on to third parties.
privacy.section3CookiesDesc: Technically necessary cookies are set on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR. They are required for the proper operation of the website and cannot be deactivated.
privacy.section3AnalyticsDesc: With your consent, we use Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd., Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland) to analyze user behavior. Legal basis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. IP anonymization is activated. Data is stored on servers in the EU. You can revoke your consent at any time (cookie settings).
privacy.section4Desc: Contact inquiries are deleted after completion of processing, at the latest after 3 years, unless there is a legal retention obligation. For tax-relevant documents, a retention period of 7 years applies according to Austrian tax law. Analytics data is automatically deleted after 14 months.
privacy.section5Desc: Your personal data will only be passed on to third parties if:
privacy.section5Item1: you have given your explicit consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR)
privacy.section5Item2: this is necessary for the performance of a contract (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR)
privacy.section5Item3: there is a legal obligation (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. c GDPR)
privacy.section5Processors: Processors used: Vercel Inc. (Hosting, USA — Standard Contractual Clauses), Google LLC (Analytics, USA — Standard Contractual Clauses).
privacy.section6Desc: You have the following rights against us as the responsible party:
privacy.section6Item1: Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR): Information about stored data
privacy.section6Item2: Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): Correction of incorrect data
privacy.section6Item3: Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): Deletion of your data
privacy.section6Item4: Right to restriction (Art. 18 GDPR): Restriction of processing
privacy.section6Item5: Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR): Objection to processing
privacy.section6Item6: Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR): Receive your data in a machine-readable format
privacy.section6Item7: Right to withdraw consent (Art. 7 para. 3 GDPR): At any time without giving reasons
privacy.section6Contact: To exercise your rights, please contact:
privacy.section7Desc: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority:
privacy.section8Desc: We use cookies and similar technologies. Details on the cookies used, purposes and your opt-out options can be found in our cookie banner on the first visit and in the cookie settings (accessible at any time via the link in the footer).
privacy.section9Desc: This privacy policy is updated when our processing activities change or when the legal situation changes. The current version is always available at www.mitcodean.com/privacy.
